positive_band.rule: good variant, longest prefix <= 256 B ending on a word boundary
positive_band.sensitivity: report M_d with and without the format-constrained items

role.scale: judge scale and dimension separation only; not key-2 gold
role.positive: proxy positive band for M_d/F_d; instruction-response, not free generation
role.negative: 3.62B generations from key2_generate.py plus section-16 salad

caveats: The cert set has 18 English items, not 20; the merged set is 18 en / 24 de / 18 zh.
The good variants are authored/reviewed reference answers, not human free generations.
The instructions are up to 195 B; the 128-B cap applies to the key-2 generation prompts, not to the judge calibration prompt.
The 256-B prefix may end mid-sentence; the judge prompt must say so.
A wrong-but-fluent cert answer can score high on key-2 dimensions; cert labels are not key-2 gold.
